about_the_game:
Step into a heroic fantasy universe where magic and strategy collide!

This multiplayer card game invites you to build your deck, cast spectacular spells, and challenge your friends or other players online. Whether you enjoy tactical duels, experimenting with unique deck builds, or simply chilling with quick matches, this game offers both accessible and deep gameplay.

Main features:

Multiplayer battles: Challenge your friends in epic duels or face off against the online community to prove your worth.

Strategic deck-building: Construct and upgrade your deck, discover countless combos, and adapt your tactics to each game.

Immersive fantasy atmosphere: Epic illustrations, spectacular spells, enchanting music.

Accessibility: Perfect for quick matches or for diving deep into crafting the ultimate deck.

Solo options: Train against the AI or take on challenges at your own pace.

Are you ready to become the realm’s greatest strategist?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 Series or equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 Series or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: A card and deck-building game where strategy is key! Face off against your friends or other players online in a heroic fantasy universe, build the perfect deck, and cast spectacular spells in intense duels.
